purpose: Boundary-level curtailment probability anchors for non_firm_compute_exposure. curtailment_prob_norm ∈ [0,1] — normalised expected constraint/curtailment intensity by GSP/boundary zone. Provisional anchors pending full NESO constraint-cost time series pull.

east_england.label: East of England / London orbit
east_england.rationale: Acute connection delays; high constraint cost share in Eastern/London boundaries.

south_wales.label: South Wales (Cardiff / Bridgend cluster)
south_wales.rationale: AI Growth Zone cluster; flagged capacity gaps and reform queue pressure.

south_west.label: South West / Wessex
south_west.rationale: Moderate constraint exposure; security-sensitive firm connections common.

southern.label: Southern / Thames Valley
southern.rationale: Government AI Growth Zone; rising demand vs limited headroom.

unknown.label: Unmapped boundary (portfolio average)
unknown.rationale: Fallback when asset boundary not resolved.
